description: Build a simple flashlight circuit on a breadboard: a push button, a 220 ohm resistor and an LED wired between the power rails with jumper wires. Connect the battery pack only after the whole circuit is assembled, then press the button to light the LED.

steps.instruction_es: Pon el pulsador en la protoboard cruzando el canal central, con dos patas a cada lado.
steps.completion_cue: The square push button is pressed into the breadboard straddling the center gap, two legs on each side.

steps.instruction_es: Ahora pon la resistencia con una pata en la fila del pulsador y la otra en una fila distinta.
steps.completion_cue: The beige banded resistor bridges two different rows, one leg in a row of the button's leg.

steps.instruction_es: Pon el LED con la pata larga en la fila de la resistencia y la pata corta en otra fila.
steps.completion_cue: The LED's long leg is in the resistor's free row and its short leg (flat rim side) is in a separate row.

steps.instruction_es: Conecta un cable jumper desde el riel rojo (+) hasta la fila de la otra pata del pulsador.
steps.completion_cue: A jumper wire runs from the red (+) rail to the row of one of the button's legs, on the side opposite the resistor.

steps.instruction_es: Conecta un cable jumper desde la fila de la pata corta del LED hasta el riel azul (−).
steps.completion_cue: A jumper wire runs from the LED's short-leg row to the blue (-) power rail.

steps.instruction_es: Ahora conecta el portapilas: cable rojo al riel rojo (+) y cable negro al riel azul (−).
steps.completion_cue: The battery holder's red lead is in the red (+) rail and the black lead is in the blue (-) rail.

steps.instruction_es: Aprieta el pulsador y mantenlo para ver si el LED se enciende.
steps.completion_cue: A finger holds the push button down and the LED is lit.

mistakes.description: The LED is inserted backwards, with the short leg (cathode) in the resistor's row, so it will not light.
mistakes.visual_cue: The flat side of the LED rim and the short leg face the resistor's row; the long leg is in the other row.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, el LED está al revés; gíralo para que la pata larga quede en la fila de la resistencia.

mistakes.description: Both resistor legs are in the same five-hole row, so the resistor is shorted and does not bridge to the LED.
mistakes.visual_cue: The resistor lies along a single row with both legs in holes of the same row.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, la resistencia tiene las dos patas en la misma fila; ponla cruzando dos filas distintas.

mistakes.description: The push button is placed entirely on one side of the center gap, which can short its legs or leave it disconnected.
mistakes.visual_cue: All four button legs are on the same side of the breadboard's center gap.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, el pulsador debe cruzar el canal central; muévelo para que quede con dos patas a cada lado.

mistakes.description: The battery pack polarity is swapped, so the LED will not light.
mistakes.visual_cue: The red battery lead is in the blue (-) rail and the black lead in the red (+) rail.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, el portapilas está invertido; pon el cable rojo en el riel rojo y el negro en el azul.

mistakes.description: The battery pack is connected to the rails before all components and jumper wires are in place.
mistakes.visual_cue: Battery leads are in the power rails while the LED, resistor or a jumper wire is still missing from the breadboard.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, desconecta el portapilas y termina de armar todo el circuito antes de conectarlo.
